scope.question: Can the current PMXT coverage ledger authorize canonical or broad Polymarket L2 backfill?
scope.answer: No. The ledger is useful rejected evidence: it proves coverage-axis metadata can be derived from the committed SourceProofReport without payload download, but both records are rejected because the PMXT source proof remains pending.

ledger_run.command: python3 scripts/rust_verification.py cargo --repo crates/backtesting-vertical-slice -- run --locked --bin backfill_coverage_ledger -- --spec /private/tmp/bte-pmxt-coverage-ledger-source-proof-20260609/pmxt-coverage-ledger.toml

claim_limits: This artifact does not accept PMXT as a durable source.
This artifact does not authorize canonical-ready PMXT backfill.
This artifact does not prove one-year or expanded coverage.
This artifact does not prove dynamic tick-size replay or an accepted bounded-exclusion policy.
next_required_evidence: Accept a durable Polymarket SourceProofReport before any coverage ledger can become canonical-ready.
Record expanded coverage, retention/freshness, completeness, storage, and exact accepted-window cost evidence under that accepted source proof.
Prove dynamic tick-size replay or accept a source-proof-bound no-tick-size-change exclusion policy before broad L2 replay claims.
